findings.issue: The description says main has 'no construction turning principal parts into actual kernel elements of L_x: the only known kernel elements were the two covariant translations'. This is false: main already constructs L² kernel elements of L_x with every admissible principal part. So the PR's claimed path to TG4 rests on a misstated state of main, and two of its three headline theorems repeat an existing capability in a new parametrization.

summary: The 2m linear-independence lower bound genuinely advances TG4's kernel identification, but the PR presents its zero-mode construction as missing from main when `KernelExistence.lean` already realizes every principal part as a smooth L² kernel element. The PR must justify the second construction or narrow to what is actually new.
